Frequently Asked Questions

What skins are in the CS:GO Weapon Case?

The CS:GO Weapon Case contains 89 weapon skins across 32 weapons and 92 rare knife/glove drops. By rarity: 11 Covert, 18 Classified, 27 Restricted, 33 Mil-Spec. The Covert skins are AK-47 | Vulcan and AWP | Lightning Strike and AK-47 | Wasteland Rebel and SSG 08 | Blood in the Water and P90 | Asiimov and M4A1-S | Cyrex and P2000 | Fire Elemental and CZ75-Auto | Victoria and Sawed-Off | The Kraken and AUG | Chameleon and M4A4 | Desert-Strike.

What is the most expensive skin in the CS:GO Weapon Case?

The most expensive regular skin from the CS:GO Weapon Case is the AK-47 | Case Hardened, currently priced at $1069.89 in Factory New. Among rare special items, knives and gloves can sell for significantly more — check the Rare Special Items section above for current prices.

What knives can you get from the CS:GO Weapon Case?

The CS:GO Weapon Case can drop 92 rare special items including Karambit | Crimson Web, M9 Bayonet | Crimson Web, Karambit | Case Hardened, Butterfly Knife | Crimson Web, M9 Bayonet | Forest DDPAT, Butterfly Knife | Ultraviolet, Flip Knife | Crimson Web, Butterfly Knife | Night and 84 more. These have approximately a 0.26% chance of dropping per opening.

What is the cheapest skin in the CS:GO Weapon Case?

The most affordable skin from the CS:GO Weapon Case is the UMP-45 | Labyrinth, starting at around $0.73 in Factory New. Mil-Spec grade skins are the most common drops and typically the most affordable.

How much does the CS:GO Weapon Case cost to open?

Opening the CS:GO Weapon Case requires the case itself (~$161.18) plus a key (~$2.50 on Steam). The total cost is approximately $163.68. Most openings return Mil-Spec or Industrial skins worth less than the opening cost, but rare Covert or knife drops can be worth many times more.

Is the CS:GO Weapon Case worth opening in 2026?

Whether the CS:GO Weapon Case is worth opening depends on the current prices of its contents. The top Covert skin (AK-47 | Case Hardened) is worth ~$1069.89, but the most common drops are Mil-Spec skins worth ~$0.73. Statistically, most case openings result in a net loss. Check all the prices on this page to evaluate the expected value.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the CS:GO Weapon Case?

Compare CS:GO Weapon Case prices across 30+ marketplaces on SteamAnalyst. Third-party markets like Skinport, BUFF163, and CSFloat often offer cases at lower prices than the Steam Community Market due to reduced fees. Prices can vary 10-30% between platforms.
